Reason: The sagittal and axial CT images demonstrate a focal outpouching at the aortic isthmus (just distal to the left subclavian artery origin) with surrounding mediastinal hematoma, which is the classic appearance of a traumatic aortic pseudoaneurysm resulting from deceleration injury. This vascular injury explains the mediastinal widening seen on imaging.
